name: 830-Point Solderless Breadboard
description: Solderless prototyping board with 830 tie-points arranged in interconnected 5-hole rows and 4 full-length dual power rails.
realWorldAnalogy: Solderless prototyping board with 830 tie-points arranged in interconnected 5-hole rows and 4 full-length dual power rails.

hazards: Do not insert wire leads thicker than 22 AWG

wiringGuidance: Always run Red jumper from Arduino 5V to the (+) rail, and Dark Slate or Black wire from GND to the (-) rail. Bridging components straddle the central trough.
commonMistakes: Assuming the power rails are continuous across the entire board—some models have a split in the middle requiring a bridge wire.
Plugging both legs of an LED or resistor into the same 5-hole column, shorting the component.

miniExperiment.title: Breadboard Power Rail Continuity Check
miniExperiment.circuit: Connect 5V to (+) rail, GND to (-) rail. Place 220-ohm resistor and Red LED across the rails.
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: The LED illuminates bright red directly from the breadboard power rail.
